outcomes.description: Wide-field sensing reported over 1100 arcsec at 30 Hz; processing reported below 30 ms on eight RTX 4090 GPUs.
Three inferred turbulence layers below 750 m and altitude resolution reported as high as 43 m. No physical height-sensor readout is provided.
R-squared means reported as 0.45 and 0.86. RMSE and FOV source conflicts remain in source_conflicts.json.
Kymograph SSIM values reported as 0.735 and 0.964 against the meta-sensor comparison.
